items.english: It was in a pale dim light, and three people, quiet like the light itself, drawn close with their heads together, telling a long story. The story seemed to go on and on between them, too long ever to come to an end. And in that story it seemed that all was told, all that is in the world, good and evil, sadness and suffering and anger and trouble and joy. But teller and listener alike only went on quietly and restfully, steadily smiling, and they did not move at all. With heads bent and eyes lowered, and there only a quiet fond remembrance and forgiveness seemed to wrap them. And there too a deep, deep restfulness showed in all of them.
notes: Left 'three people' indefinite rather than 'the three' to keep the figures suspended as in the Japanese, which does not say who they are.

items.english: All things in the world, life, will pass. And only on the day it has passed will all, all things, turn into fond remembrance and forgiveness. And then they will be forever before a rest like night.
notes: Kept 'rest' for An-soku in plain diction without religious lift, and kept 'fond remembrance and forgiveness' as the fixed pair repeated elsewhere.

items.english: The distant picture lay dark and quiet in the bottom of her eyes. And through the bottom of her eyes, far off in the future, with a lonely restfulness, that picture could be seen. Young as she was, alone she gave a lonely quiet sigh, and with a glance at the table left in disorder and at the faces of her husband and child, she remained silent.

data.say: Drafted the vision passage plain with figures and day left unresolved.
